description: Permutation test of the empirical eigenvalue spectrum against the column-scrambled null, all datasets at B=2000, reporting the assumption-free empirical p-value. All scrambled eigenvalues for ranks 1..50 are saved.
null_hypothesis: genes are mutually independent (no gene-gene correlation)
null_construction: independent permutation of each gene (column) across cells; reproduces src/analysis_functions.scramble

parameters.rng: numpy default_rng (PCG64), one independent stream per sample

saved_artifacts.note: full spectra per replicate were not stored (~240 MB); ranks 1..50 are stored draw-by-draw and all remaining ranks are summarised in the moments file

appended.seed_block: SEED + 2000 + i over the sorted added samples
appended.note: existing samples were not recomputed; their seeds and results are unchanged from the original run
